headline: Reddit experiments with video and audio versions of posts
summary: The social media giant is testing new ways for users to experience content beyond text, aiming to boost engagement.
details: Reddit is rolling out a limited experiment that allows users to listen to posts or watch them as short-form videos. This move aims to make the platform's content more interactive and engaging.
While the new formats will link back to the original text posts and comments, these will remain unchanged. The experiment is currently affecting a sample of posts across select communities.

This initiative is part of a broader strategy to attract new users and retain existing ones. CEO Steve Huffman noted the potential for 'spoken-Reddit' to be highly engaging, drawing parallels to podcasts that read Reddit content.
The company has recently expanded its video features, including the introduction of video comments in June, allowing users to post videos in comment threads.
caption:
Reddit is testing video and audio versions of posts, moving beyond its text-heavy format.

Reddit is rolling out a limited experiment that allows users to listen to posts or watch them as short-form videos. This move aims to make the platform's content more interactive and engaging.

While the new formats will link back to the original text posts and comments, these will remain unchanged. The experiment is currently affecting a sample of posts across select communities.

This initiative is part of a broader strategy to attract new users and retain existing ones. CEO Steve Huffman noted the potential for 'spoken-Reddit' to be highly engaging, drawing parallels to podcasts that read Reddit content.

The company has recently expanded its video features, including the introduction of video comments in June, allowing users to post videos in comment threads.
